data.score: float64 cosine(emb, emb[qidx]) precomputed as column s<q>; queries are table rows, so max s = 1

references: numpy float64, per frame from scratch; F = the SQL's own formula exp((s-1)/eps), T = per-frame max-shifted softmax

sql.q0_eps0.001_k50:
SELECT id,
       category,
       ts,
       rating,
       sum(w * rating) OVER win / sum(w) OVER win AS rolling_weighted_avg_rating
FROM (
    SELECT id,
           category,
           ts,
           rating,
           exp((s0 - 1.0) / 0.001) AS w
    FROM reviews
) s
WINDOW win AS (
    PARTITION BY category
    ORDER BY ts, id
    ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)
ORDER BY category, ts, id
